$comment: Proposed th additions to src/data/claims-lint.json and src/data/keyword-map.json (M3, wave 2). Not merged: the lead merges.

Thai has no spaces between words, so the patterns are plain substrings; [^ ]{0,n} stays inside one Thai phrase (Thai separates phrases with spaces). No \b: Thai letters are word characters on both sides of a Thai word boundary.

The th copy carries U+2060 word joiners inside some words (line-break hints, doc 05 §3.5). The validators match raw strings, so a joiner inside a banned phrase would hide it: the QA record asks the lead to strip U+2060 before matching (validate-util rendered() / dom textOf()). The th copy was checked both with and without the joiners.
